links.outcome: Detection of performance decline in deployed imaging models via automated monitoring
links.effect: Performance discrepancies between test and inference data were detected in eight of 18 models, prompting fine-tuning workflows that reduced performance gaps.
links.quote: Performance discrepancies between test and inference data were detected in eight of 18 models, prompting fine-tuning workflows that reduced performance gaps.

links.outcome: Performance restoration after fine-tuning models with declined performance
links.effect: In cases with declines of up to 40.6% (cardiomegaly dataset, InceptionV3), fine-tuning restored performance metrics to within ±2% of baseline values.

unlisted_practices: LLM multiagent system that automatically triggers fine-tuning with parameter-anchoring regularization to limit catastrophic forgetting

screen.practice: automated performance drift monitoring with triggered fine-tuning
screen.reason: Evaluates an automated multiagent monitoring and recalibration/fine-tuning framework specifically designed as postmarket surveillance to detect and correct performance decline/drift in medical imaging models.

primary.practice: automated performance drift monitoring and targeted fine-tuning
